name: deepseekv41_mxfp8_linear_x_scale_x_float8_e4m3fn_n4096_k1280
description: sglang's MXFP8 linear of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer on gfx950 (aiter_mxfp8_blockscaled_linear, and each group of the wo_a projection's BMM), before any bias: x @ weight.T, weight fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 x 32 block. A bf16 x is first rounded to fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 values of a row, the scale 2**ceil(log2(amax / 448)) of the block's largest magnitude, never below 1e-30; an fp8 x comes with those scales.

x.description: Activations: bf16, or the fp8 values x_scale scales.

x_scale.description: Per 32 values of a row of an fp8 x.
